# FleetView

> Browser-based warehouse robot fleet planner: draw a floor plan, place a robot fleet, and simulate throughput, congestion and payback entirely in the browser.

FleetView plans multi-robot routes with Conflict-Based Search (CBS), a multi-agent pathfinding algorithm that resolves shared-aisle conflicts optimally instead of letting robots deadlock nose to nose. CBS drives a deterministic discrete-event simulation in a Web Worker: orders arrive on a seeded random process, robots pick, deposit and charge, and the same seed always produces the same result. Outputs include orders per hour, robot utilisation, latency p95, a congestion heatmap, fleet-size sweeps to find the saturation point, and a payback model against hardware and labour costs. The app ships as static files with no backend and makes no network calls at runtime.

- [Live app](https://fleetview-kappa.vercel.app/)
